John Clayton Carter, the son of Lethia Coker and Hopewell Carter, Jr. , was born in Cumberland Co., NJ on 6 November, 1932. He married Christine Harris on 11 January, 1958. John and Christine had the following children: John Cyrus Carter (1958- ) James Carter (1964- )
